scope: Production-generated recruits, first eligible founder per seed with required groups; no stat or star selection. Saved natural gains and legal purchases, XP explicitly granted for level checkpoints. Identical spending ceilings (400/600/800), actual spend and reserves recorded; kit prices differ. Two fixed supporting allies and three authored opponents per encounter; flat open field, two seeds, both sides. AI policies paired on identical starting units and seed. This is a controlled sample, not proof of universal build balance or natural campaign pacing. Both policies use Double Grip. Survival counts HP > 0, including escaped fighters; remained and escaped are reported separately. Last-attack rounds identify prolonged inactivity.
baseline_verification: All 648 prior-policy rows reproduce shipped 0.22 results exactly. Historical survived/team_survivors fields map to remained/team_remained; current survival means HP > 0, including escaped fighters. All 54 generated profiles are unchanged.
